description: This file defines the RedirectMain activity class for an Android application, managing UI interactions and launching other activities for data input and preferences handling.

classes.name: RedirectMain
classes.description: Main activity for the redirection example, manages UI and preferences, and handles activity results.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, sets up button click listeners, and starts the preference-loading process if necessary.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from launched activities, updating preferences or finishing the activity based on user actions.

methods.name: loadPrefs
methods.description: Loads the redirect text preference and updates the TextView accordingly.
